name: Abandon

text_groups.text:
[Reaction] _(Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)_
Counter a spell. Return it to its owner’s hand instead of putting it in their trash.
[Predict]. _(Look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)_

[反应]（可在任意时机打出，甚至先于其他法术和技能的结算。）
无效化一个法术。让其返回所属的手牌，而不是将其放入废牌堆。
进行[洞察]。（查看你主牌堆顶部的一张牌。你可以选择将其回收。）

window: 法术结算；固有反应
bindings: spell:ChainItem=所选法术
source_program:
ops.counter(spell, destination=spell.owner.hand)
ops.predict(p)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('counter', {'positional': (spell,), 'keywords': {'destination': spell.owner.hand}}) as f1:
    p.chain_cancel(f1.item)
    if f1.has_card:
        p.zone_change([f1.card], f1.chain_zone, f1.leave_destination)
with action_frame('predict', {'positional': (player,), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    p.information_access(f2.looked, [f2.player], mode='LOOK', duration=UNTIL_EFFECT_END)
    f2.bind_recycle_choice(flow.Choose(player=f2.player, kind='object', candidates=f2.looked, minimum=0, maximum=f2.count, targeting=False, stage='resolution', shortage='as_many_as_possible'))
    if f2.to_recycle:
        with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': (f2.to_recycle,), 'keywords': {}}) as recycled:
            p.order_change(f2.to_recycle, f2.main_deck, position='bottom', order=f2.recycle_order)
    if f2.kept_on_top:
        p.order_change(f2.kept_on_top, f2.main_deck, position='top', order=f2.chosen_top_order)
review: 反应入口与无效化后回拥有者手牌保持同一法术；先取消链项再走离链区域替代，随后洞察独立信息授权及可选回收，不把放逐流转覆盖遗漏。

name: Acceptable Losses

text_groups.text:
[Action] _(Play on your turn or in showdowns.)_
Each player kills one of their gear.

[迅捷]（可在你的回合或法术对决中打出。）
每名玩家摧毁自己的一件装备。

[行動] _(可在你的回合或法術對決時打出)_

window: 法术结算，固有迅捷
bindings: players:list[Player]=所有玩家;chosen:dict[Player,Selection[Gear]]=各玩家结算中非目标挑选自己一装备，无则空
primitive_program:

    for actor in players:
        with action_frame('kill', {'positional': (chosen[actor],), 'keywords': {'actor': actor}}) as f1:
            p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.owner_trash)

name: Adaptatron

text_groups.text: When I conquer, you may kill a gear. If you do, buff me. _(If I don’t have a buff, I get a +1 :rb_might: buff.)_
当我征服一处战场时，你可以选择摧毁一件装备，以此给予我增益。（如果我未拥有增益，则获得一个:rb_might:+1增益。）
當我征服一處戰場，你可以摧毀1件裝備。如果你這麼做，強化我_(如果我尚無增益，則獲得+1 :rb_might:)_。

window: 自身征服后，可选摧毁任意装备，实际如此做才增益
bindings: g:Gear=所选装备，不限己方
primitive_program:
with action_frame('kill', {'positional': ([g],), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
    p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.owner_trash)
r = f1.result
if r.value:
    with action_frame('buff', {'positional': ([me],), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
        p.stack_change(f2.objects, 'BUFF', 'ADD', 1)
review: EN/TC的If you do取实际摧毁回执，保留SC连接词差异；可杀任意装备而非只己方，只有原kill实际完成才给自身新增BUFF，原已增益则不再新增。
source_issues: LANG:SC用以此连接而EN/TC为If you do；规范分解按EN为结算效果，不把kill提前作触发成本。

bindings: first:bool=本回合该实例第1次移动;second:bool=第2次;top:Card=己主牌堆顶;bundle:ResourceBundle=Energy1和任意Power1;permit:PermissionSpec=仅允许p正常付费从放逐区打出本次top;expiry:Duration=截至p下一个Ending阶段开始，当前已在Ending则指下次而非补回已过时点
primitive_program:

    with action_frame('add_resources', {'positional': (player, bundle), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
        p.resource_credit(f1.player, f1.resources, restriction=f1.restriction, expires=f1.expires)
if second:
    with action_frame('banish', {'positional': ([top],), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
        p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.owner_banishment)

text_groups.text: :rb_energy_1: :rb_rune_order:, :rb_exhaust:: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may play a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
支付:rb_energy_1:和:rb_rune_order:，:rb_exhaust:：摧毁一名友方单位，然后查看主牌堆顶部的五张牌。你可以选择从中打出一名战力比被摧毁单位最多高1点的单位卡牌，无视费用，然后回收其余的卡牌。
:rb_energy_1: :rb_rune_order:、:rb_exhaust:：擊殺1個友方單位。查看你的主牌堆最上方的5張卡牌。你可以放逐其中1個戰力比被擊殺單位高最多1點的單位，無視費用將其直接打出，然後回收其餘卡牌。

window: 主动Energy1/Order1横置，杀友军看5，按勘误放逐合格单位免费打出，余回收
bindings: cost:Cost=Energy1/Order1及横置me;binding:CostBinding=主动基础费用;u:Unit=要杀的友军;v:Card=顶5中可选单位，战力≤u死亡前战力+1;take:bool=选择打出;dest:Location=该单位正常合法目的地;rest:Selection[Card]=顶5中除本次选中v以外的牌，未选则全部;permit:PlayPermission=本条能力授权该次所选并放逐的卡从己放逐区打出，其他限制仍检查
source_program:
base_paid = ops.pay(p, cost, binding=binding)
if base_paid.value is not None:
    ops.kill([u])
    ops.look(p, p.main_deck, 5)
    if take:
        ops.banish([v])
        ops.play(v, p, origin=p.banishment, destination=dest, cost_policy=IGNORE_BASE_COST, permission=permit)
    ops.recycle(rest)
primitive_program:
base_paid = flow.Pay(player=player, cost=cost, binding=binding)
if base_paid.value is not None:
    with action_frame('kill', {'positional': ([u],), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.owner_trash)
    with action_frame('look', {'positional': (player, player.main_deck, 5), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
        p.information_access(f2.objects, [f2.player], mode='LOOK', duration=UNTIL_EFFECT_END)
    if take:
        with action_frame('banish', {'positional': ([v],), 'keywords': {}}) as f3:
            p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.origin, f3.owner_banishment)
        with action_frame('play', {'positional': (v, player), 'keywords': {'origin': player.banishment, 'destination': dest, 'cost_policy': IGNORE_BASE_COST, 'permission': permit}}) as f4:
            with phase('start'):
                if f4.new_template:
                    born = p.instantiate(f4.template, f4.count, owner=f4.owner, controller=f4.controller, initial=f4.entry)
                    f4.bind_newborn(born.value)
                p.zone_change(f4.objects, f4.origin, f4.chain_zone)
            with phase('enter_permanent'):
                p.zone_change(f4.objects, f4.chain_zone, f4.board, entry=f4.entry, entry_location=f4.entry_locations)
            with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
                p.zone_change(f4.objects, f4.chain_zone, f4.leave_destination)
    with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': (rest,), 'keywords': {}}) as f5:
        with flow.Batch(policy=SIMULTANEOUS):
            for group in f5.recycle_groups:
                if group.same_zone:
                    p.order_change(group.objects, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)
                else:
                    p.zone_change(group.objects, group.origin, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)

if paid.value is not None:
    ops.change_empowerment([me], "empower")
# 解除强化主动

if paid.value is not None:
    ops.modify_cost(next_unit, change, duration=THIS_TURN, uses=1)
    ops.on_event(events, bind, duration=THIS_TURN, timing="inline", limit=UsageLimit(count=1, consume="on_finalize"))
# next单位before-finalize内联体
ops.grant_ability(u, kill_end, duration=THIS_TURN)
# 被授回合末触发体

paid = flow.Pay(player=player, cost=ecost, binding=eb)
if paid.value is not None:

        p.stack_change(f1.objects, 'EMPOWER_LAYER', f1.stack_operation, 1)
paid = flow.Pay(player=player, cost=cost, binding=binding)

with action_frame('kill', {'positional': (self_unit,), 'keywords': {}}) as f4:
    p.zone_change(f4.objects, f4.origin, f4.owner_trash)

window: 打出或自身据守洞察3；绝念放逐己顶可忽略Energy打出
bindings: top:Card=己主牌堆顶;take:bool=选择打出;dest:Location/Zone=该牌合法目的地;policy:CostPolicy=仅忽略Energy，仍支付Power与其他成本;permit:PlayPermission=本条能力授权该次所选并放逐的卡从己放逐区打出，其他限制仍检查
source_program:
# 打出/据守入口
ops.predict(p, 3)
# 绝念入口
ops.banish([top])
if take:
    ops.play(top, p, origin=p.banishment, destination=dest, cost_policy=policy, permission=permit)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('predict', {'positional': (player, 3), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
    p.information_access(f1.looked, [f1.player], mode='LOOK', duration=UNTIL_EFFECT_END)
    f1.bind_recycle_choice(flow.Choose(player=f1.player, kind='object', candidates=f1.looked, minimum=0, maximum=f1.count, targeting=False, stage='resolution', shortage='as_many_as_possible'))
    if f1.to_recycle:
        with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': (f1.to_recycle,), 'keywords': {}}) as recycled:
            p.order_change(f1.to_recycle, f1.main_deck, position='bottom', order=f1.recycle_order)
    if f1.kept_on_top:
        p.order_change(f1.kept_on_top, f1.main_deck, position='top', order=f1.chosen_top_order)
with action_frame('banish', {'positional': ([top],), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.owner_banishment)
if take:
    with action_frame('play', {'positional': (top, player), 'keywords': {'origin': player.banishment, 'destination': dest, 'cost_policy': policy, 'permission': permit}}) as f3:
        with phase('start'):
            if f3.new_template:
                born = p.instantiate(f3.template, f3.count, owner=f3.owner, controller=f3.controller, initial=f3.entry)
                f3.bind_newborn(born.value)
            p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.origin, f3.chain_zone)
        with phase('enter_permanent'):
            p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.chain_zone, f3.board, entry=f3.entry, entry_location=f3.entry_locations)
        with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
            p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.chain_zone, f3.leave_destination)

window: 打出展示各对手顶牌，选1放逐免费由p打，余回收
bindings: tops:Selection[Card]=各对手主牌堆顶牌;c:Card=其中选一;rest:Selection[Card]=未选展示牌;dest:Location/Zone=所选牌合法目的地
source_program:
ops.reveal(tops)
ops.banish([c])
ops.play(c, p, origin=c.owner.banishment, destination=dest, cost_policy=IGNORE_BASE_COST)
ops.recycle(rest)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('reveal', {'positional': (tops,), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
    p.information_access(f1.objects, f1.viewers, mode='REVEAL', duration=f1.duration)
with action_frame('banish', {'positional': ([c],), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.owner_banishment)
with action_frame('play', {'positional': (c, player), 'keywords': {'origin': c.owner.banishment, 'destination': dest, 'cost_policy': IGNORE_BASE_COST}}) as f3:
    with phase('start'):
        if f3.new_template:
            born = p.instantiate(f3.template, f3.count, owner=f3.owner, controller=f3.controller, initial=f3.entry)
            f3.bind_newborn(born.value)
        p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.origin, f3.chain_zone)
    with phase('enter_permanent'):
        p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.chain_zone, f3.board, entry=f3.entry, entry_location=f3.entry_locations)
    with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
        p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.chain_zone, f3.leave_destination)
with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': (rest,), 'keywords': {}}) as f4:
    with flow.Batch(policy=SIMULTANEOUS):
        for group in f4.recycle_groups:
            if group.same_zone:
                p.order_change(group.objects, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)
            else:
                p.zone_change(group.objects, group.origin, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)

[Hidden] _(Hide now for :rb_rune_rainbow: to react with later for :rb_energy_0:.)_
[Action] _(Play on your turn or in showdowns.)_
Move a unit from a battlefield to its base.

[待命]（支付:rb_rune_rainbow:正面朝下放置此牌，之后可支付:rb_energy_0:将其当作反应牌打出。）
[迅捷]（可在你的回合或法术对决中打出。）
将一名单位从战场上移动到其所属的基地。

[待命] _(支付:rb_rune_rainbow:覆蓋此牌，之後可支付:rb_energy_0:使其重新成為反應牌)_
[行動] _(可在你的回合或法術對決時打出)_
移動一處戰場上的1個單位到其基地。

name: Find Your Center

text_groups.text:
[Action] _(Play on your turn or in showdowns.)_
If an opponent’s score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, this costs :rb_energy_2: less.
Draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted.

[迅捷]（可在你的回合或法术对决中打出。）
如果对手得分距离胜利得分不超过3分，则此法术的费用减少:rb_energy_2:。
抽一张牌，然后召出一枚休眠的符文。

[行動] _(可在你的回合或法術對決時打出)_
如果一位對手距離勝利分數僅在3分內，此牌費用減:rb_energy_2:。
抽1張卡牌並召喚1枚休眠狀態的符文。

window: 征服此处后，本回合下一打出单位获得急速
bindings: events:EventPattern=p本回合下一单位PLAY的before_finalize;bind:Ability=下方内联授予体;unit:Selection[Card]=该次PLAY真实单位card;THIS_PLAY:Duration=该段明确的当前打出及其相关定稿入场结算流程

name: Fizz, Trickster

text_groups.text: When you play me, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost no more than :rb_energy_3:, ignoring its Energy cost. Recycle that spell after you play it. _(You must still pay its Power cost.)_
当你打出我时，你可以选择从你的废牌堆中打出一个法力费用不高于:rb_energy_3:的法术，无需支付其法力费用（仍需支付所有符能费用）。打出该法术后，将其回收。

window: 打出可从己废牌打Energy≤3法术，仅忽略Energy，随后回收该法术
bindings: c:Card=p废牌Energy≤3法术;policy:CostPolicy=只忽略Energy保留Power;permit:PlayPermission=触发授权该次从p废牌打c;chain:Zone=链;events:EventPattern=play回执指定item已定稿后LEAVE_CHAIN且非自身指令离链;rewrite:EventRewrite=取消原离链入废，以recycle_body替代;recycle_body:Ability=下方回收体;UNTIL_ITEM_LEAVES_CHAIN:Duration=直到该段关联链项离链替代处理完成
source_program:
played = ops.play(c, p, origin=p.trash, destination=chain, cost_policy=policy, permission=permit)
if played.value is not None:
    ops.replace_event(events, rewrite, duration=UNTIL_ITEM_LEAVES_CHAIN)
# 离链替代体
ops.recycle([c])
primitive_program:
with action_frame('play', {'positional': (c, player), 'keywords': {'origin': player.trash, 'destination': chain, 'cost_policy': policy, 'permission': permit}}) as f1:
    with phase('start'):
        if f1.new_template:
            born = p.instantiate(f1.template, f1.count, owner=f1.owner, controller=f1.controller, initial=f1.entry)
            f1.bind_newborn(born.value)
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.chain_zone)
    with phase('enter_permanent'):
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.board, entry=f1.entry, entry_location=f1.entry_locations)
    with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.leave_destination)
played = f1.result
if played.value is not None:
    flow.Register(ability=ReplacementAbility(events=events, rewrite=rewrite, optional=False), duration=UNTIL_ITEM_LEAVES_CHAIN)
with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': ([c],), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    with flow.Batch(policy=SIMULTANEOUS):

text_groups.text:
At the start of your Beginning Phase, if you have exactly 4 cards in hand and exactly 4 units at battlefields, you win the game.
Discard 1, :rb_exhaust:: Play a 1 :rb_might: Bird unit token with [Deflect]. _(Opponents must pay :rb_rune_rainbow: to choose it with a spell or ability.)_

在你的开始阶段开始时，如果你有且仅有四张手牌，且你在各处战场上有且仅有四名单位，则立即赢得对局。

window: 自己开始阶段恰4手牌且战场己军总计恰4直接胜；主动弃1横置打Bird
bindings: authorization:WinAuthorization=该卡开始阶段触发中两项恰4条件已满足的明示胜利授权;cost:Cost=弃1及横置me;binding:CostBinding=主动基础费用;bird:TokenTemplate=完整1战力Deflect的Bird;dest:Location=合法打出地点
source_program:
# 条件满足的开始阶段触发
ops.win(p, authorization=authorization)
# 独立主动
paid = ops.pay(p, cost, binding=binding)
if paid.value is not None:
    ops.play(bird, p, origin=None, destination=dest)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('win', {'positional': (player,), 'keywords': {'authorization': authorization}}) as f1:
    p.outcome_set(f1.player, authorization=f1.authorization)
paid = flow.Pay(player=player, cost=cost, binding=binding)
if paid.value is not None:
    with action_frame('play', {'positional': (bird, player), 'keywords': {'origin': None, 'destination': dest}}) as f2:
        with phase('start'):
            if f2.new_template:
                born = p.instantiate(f2.template, f2.count, owner=f2.owner, controller=f2.controller, initial=f2.entry)
                f2.bind_newborn(born.value)
            p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.chain_zone)
        with phase('enter_permanent'):
            p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.chain_zone, f2.board, entry=f2.entry, entry_location=f2.entry_locations)
        with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
            p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.chain_zone, f2.leave_destination)

bindings: u:Unit=定稿选择的战场敌军实例，结算重检且离区不追踪新对象;link:Link=本法术该单位与该次控制修饰关联;ending_start_is_future:bool=本回合Ending阶段开始时点尚未过去；规则359.3.e.16已过时为False;ending_event:EventPattern=本回合TURN_PHASE的start，phase为Ending，保存当前回合身份;once:UsageLimit=count为1且reset为never;return_ability:Ability=完整延迟触发，controller为p，保存u及本次control_modifiers引用，执行下方两步
source_program:
control = ops.change_control([u], p, duration=PERMANENT, link=link)
control_modifiers = control.value or []
ops.orient([u], "ready")
if ending_start_is_future:
    ops.on_event(ending_event, return_ability, duration=THIS_TURN, limit=once, link=link)
# return_ability结算体；以上取得的引用被保存在延迟能力参数中
ops.end_modifier(control_modifiers, link=link)
ops.recall([u])
primitive_program:
with action_frame('change_control', {'positional': ([u], player), 'keywords': {'duration': PERMANENT, 'link': link}}) as f1:
    p.control_contribute(f1.objects, f1.player, duration=f1.duration, link=f1.link)
control = f1.result
control_modifiers = control.value or []
with action_frame('orient', {'positional': ([u], 'ready'), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    p.orientation_set(f2.objects, f2.state)
if ending_start_is_future:
    flow.Register(ability=AbilityBinding(definition=return_ability, entry=EventEntry(events=ending_event, delivery='triggered')), duration=THIS_TURN, limit=once, link=link)
with action_frame('end_modifier', {'positional': (control_modifiers,), 'keywords': {'link': link}}) as f3:
    p.effect_end(f3.handles, link=f3.link)
with action_frame('recall', {'positional': ([u],), 'keywords': {}}) as f4:
    p.location_change(f4.objects, f4.controller_bases)

# 打出触发入口

    if r.value and take_play:

            with phase('enter_permanent'):
                p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.chain_zone, f2.board, entry=f2.entry, entry_location=f2.entry_locations)

name: Noxian Drummer

text_groups.text: When I move to a battlefield, play a 1 :rb_might: Recruit unit token here. _(It is also at the battlefield.)_
当我移动到一处战场时，在此处打出一名1:rb_might:的“随从”（它也位于此战场）。
當我移動到戰場，在此處打出一名1 :rb_might:“侍從” _(該侍從也位於此戰場)_。

window: 自身MOVE目的地是战场的完成事件；效果在执行时here打随从，按当前源位置或适用LKI解析
bindings: recruit:TokenTemplate=1战力Recruit
source_program: ops.play(recruit, p, origin=None, destination=here)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('play', {'positional': (recruit, player), 'keywords': {'origin': None, 'destination': here}}) as f1:
    with phase('start'):
        if f1.new_template:
            born = p.instantiate(f1.template, f1.count, owner=f1.owner, controller=f1.controller, initial=f1.entry)
            f1.bind_newborn(born.value)
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.chain_zone)
    with phase('enter_permanent'):
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.board, entry=f1.entry, entry_location=f1.entry_locations)
    with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.leave_destination)

name: Noxian Emissary

text_groups.text:
[Empower :rb_energy_1: :rb_rune_order:] _(:rb_energy_1: :rb_rune_order:: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)_
[Empowered][>][>>][Deathknell][>] Play two 1 :rb_might: Recruit unit tokens to your base. _(When I die while Empowered, get the effect.)_

[强化1:rb_rune_order:]（支付:rb_energy_1:和:rb_rune_order:：强化我。仅在未强化时可用。）
[已强化][>][>绝念][>] 打出两名1:rb_might:的“随从”到你的基地。（当我在已强化状态下被摧毁时，发动此效果。）

window: 强化Energy1/Order1；以强化状态死亡才在基地打2随从
bindings: cost:Cost=Energy1/Order1;binding:CostBinding=仅未强化主动基础费用;recruit:TokenTemplate=1战力Recruit
source_program:
# 强化
paid = ops.pay(p, cost, binding=binding)
if paid.value is not None:
    ops.change_empowerment([me], "empower")
# 死亡前强化状态为真的绝念
for i in range(2):
    ops.play(recruit, p, origin=None, destination=p.base)
primitive_program:
paid = flow.Pay(player=player, cost=cost, binding=binding)
if paid.value is not None:
    with action_frame('change_empowerment', {'positional': ([me], 'empower'), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
        p.stack_change(f1.objects, 'EMPOWER_LAYER', f1.stack_operation, 1)
for i in range(2):
    with action_frame('play', {'positional': (recruit, player), 'keywords': {'origin': None, 'destination': player.base}}) as f2:
        with phase('start'):
            if f2.new_template:
                born = p.instantiate(f2.template, f2.count, owner=f2.owner, controller=f2.controller, initial=f2.entry)
                f2.bind_newborn(born.value)
            p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.chain_zone)
        with phase('enter_permanent'):
            p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.chain_zone, f2.board, entry=f2.entry, entry_location=f2.entry_locations)
        with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
            p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.chain_zone, f2.leave_destination)

name: Noxian Guillotine

text_groups.text:
[Action] _(Play on your turn or in showdowns.)_
Choose a unit. Kill it the next time it takes damage this turn.
[Legion] — Kill it now instead. _(Get the effect if you’ve played another card this turn.)_

[迅捷]（可在你的回合或法术对决中打出。）
选择一名单位，在它本回合下次受到伤害时，将其摧毁。
[鼓舞]—改为立即将其摧毁。（如果你在本回合内已打出过其他卡牌，则发动此效果。）

[行動] _(可在你的回合或法術對決時打出)_
選擇1個單位。本回合該單位下次受到傷害時，將其擊殺。
[軍團] — 改為立刻擊殺該單位_(如果你在本回合打出過其他卡牌，獲得此效果)_。

window: 迅捷法术，鼓舞则立刻杀所选单位，否则本回合下一次受伤后杀
bindings: u:Unit=所选单位;legion:bool=本回合已打出另一卡;events:EventPattern=u本回合下一次实际正数DAMAGE.complete;ability:Ability=下方延迟摧毁体;limit:UsageLimit=一次on_accept;link:Link=该所选u实例
primitive_program:
if legion:
    with action_frame('kill', {'positional': ([u],), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.owner_trash)
else:
    flow.Register(ability=AbilityBinding(definition=ability, entry=EventEntry(events=events, delivery='triggered')), duration=THIS_TURN, limit=limit, link=link)
with action_frame('kill', {'positional': ([u],), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.owner_trash)

name: Ntofo Strikes

text_groups.text:
[Action] _(Play on your turn or in showdowns.)_
Give a friendly unit [Shield 2] this turn, then deal damage equal to its [Shield] to an enemy unit. _(A unit with Shield has +1 :rb_might: for each instance of Shield while it’s a defender.)_

[迅捷]（可在你的回合或法术对决中打出。）
给予一名友方单位在本回合内[坚守2]，然后对一名敌方单位造成等同于该友方单位[坚守]数值的伤害。（只要具有坚守的单位是防守方，每点坚守便提供:rb_might:+1。）

window: 迅捷法术，友方单位坚守2本回合，再法术对任意敌军按该军新坚守值伤害
bindings: u:Unit=所选友方单位;v:Unit=所选敌军，不限战场;params:KeywordParameters=Shield.value为2;n:IntExpr=授予后u的当前Shield总值，不是只有新加的2
source_program:
ops.grant_keyword([u], SHIELD, parameters=params, duration=THIS_TURN)
ops.damage([v], n)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('grant_keyword', {'positional': ([u], SHIELD), 'keywords': {'parameters': params, 'duration': THIS_TURN}}) as f1:
    for definition in f1.keyword_definitions:
        p.ability_add(f1.objects, definition, duration=f1.duration, link=f1.keyword_link)
with action_frame('damage', {'positional': ([v], n), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    p.damage_record(f2.objects, f2.actual_damage_map, source=f2.source, actor=f2.actor)

            with action_frame('draw', {'positional': (actor, 1), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:

for actor in actors:

name: Portal Rescue

text_groups.text:
[Action] _(Play on your turn or in showdowns.)_
Banish a friendly unit, then play it to base, ignoring its cost.

[迅捷]（可在你的回合或法术对决中打出。）
放逐一名友方单位，然后让其拥有者将它打出到其所属的基地，无视费用。

[行動] _(可在你的回合或法術對決時打出)_
放逐1個友方單位，然後其擁有者無視費用將其打到基地。

window: 迅捷法术，放逐友方单位，再按勘误由拥有者免费打到其基地
bindings: u:Unit=所选友方单位;owner:Player=u拥有者;permit:PlayPermission=本法术授权该次放逐后的实体由拥有者从其放逐区打到自己基地，仍查合法性与其他费用
source_program:
ops.banish([u])
ops.play(u, owner, origin=owner.banishment, destination=owner.base, cost_policy=IGNORE_BASE_COST, permission=permit)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('banish', {'positional': ([u],), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
    p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.owner_banishment)
with action_frame('play', {'positional': (u, owner), 'keywords': {'origin': owner.banishment, 'destination': owner.base, 'cost_policy': IGNORE_BASE_COST, 'permission': permit}}) as f2:
    with phase('start'):
        if f2.new_template:
            born = p.instantiate(f2.template, f2.count, owner=f2.owner, controller=f2.controller, initial=f2.entry)
            f2.bind_newborn(born.value)
        p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.chain_zone)
    with phase('enter_permanent'):
        p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.chain_zone, f2.board, entry=f2.entry, entry_location=f2.entry_locations)
    with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
        p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.chain_zone, f2.leave_destination)

primitive_program:
with action_frame('look', {'positional': (player, player.main_deck, 5), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
    p.information_access(f1.objects, [f1.player], mode='LOOK', duration=UNTIL_EFFECT_END)
top = f1.result.value
u = flow.Choose(player=player, kind='object', candidates=[c for c in top if 'unit' in c.types], minimum=0, maximum=1, stage='resolution', targeting=False, shortage='as_many_as_possible').value
if u:
    with action_frame('banish', {'positional': (u,), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
        p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.owner_banishment)
    with action_frame('modify_cost', {'positional': (subject, discount), 'keywords': {'duration': THIS_PLAY}}) as f3:
        p.cost_rule_add(f3.subjects, f3.rule, duration=f3.duration, limit=f3.limit, link=f3.link)
    with action_frame('play', {'positional': (u[0], player), 'keywords': {'origin': player.banishment, 'destination': dest, 'permission': permit}}) as f4:
        with phase('start'):
            if f4.new_template:
                born = p.instantiate(f4.template, f4.count, owner=f4.owner, controller=f4.controller, initial=f4.entry)

        with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
            p.zone_change(f4.objects, f4.chain_zone, f4.leave_destination)
with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': ([c for c in top if c not in u],), 'keywords': {}}) as f5:

                p.zone_change(group.objects, group.origin, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)

[绝念][>] 从你的手牌中打出一名单位到你的基地，无视其法力费用。（当我被摧毁后，发动此效果。仍需支付所有符能费用。）

window: 移动到战场看3可展示单位抽该牌回收余牌；死亡从手牌打出单位至基地仅忽略能量
bindings: units:list[Card]=死亡效果p手牌单位;ignore_energy:CostPolicy=仅忽略Energy保留Power
source_program:
# 移动到战场触发
top = ops.look(p, p.main_deck, 3).value
u = ops.choose(p, [c for c in top if "unit" in c.types], minimum=0, targeting=False, bind_at="resolution").value
if u:
    ops.reveal(u)
    ops.draw(p, 1, cards=u)
ops.recycle([c for c in top if c not in u])
# Deathknell死亡触发
card = ops.choose(p, units, targeting=False, bind_at="resolution").value
if card:
    ops.play(card[0], p, origin=p.hand, destination=p.base, cost_policy=ignore_energy)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('look', {'positional': (player, player.main_deck, 3), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
    p.information_access(f1.objects, [f1.player], mode='LOOK', duration=UNTIL_EFFECT_END)
top = f1.result.value
u = flow.Choose(player=player, kind='object', candidates=[c for c in top if 'unit' in c.types], minimum=0, maximum=1, stage='resolution', targeting=False, shortage='as_many_as_possible').value
if u:
    with action_frame('reveal', {'positional': (u,), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
        p.information_access(f2.objects, f2.viewers, mode='REVEAL', duration=f2.duration)
    with action_frame('draw', {'positional': (player, 1), 'keywords': {'cards': u}}) as f3:
        p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.origin, f3.destination)
with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': ([c for c in top if c not in u],), 'keywords': {}}) as f4:
    with flow.Batch(policy=SIMULTANEOUS):
        for group in f4.recycle_groups:
            if group.same_zone:
                p.order_change(group.objects, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)
            else:
                p.zone_change(group.objects, group.origin, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)
card = flow.Choose(player=player, kind='object', candidates=units, minimum=1, maximum=1, stage='resolution', targeting=False, shortage='as_many_as_possible').value
if card:
    with action_frame('play', {'positional': (card[0], player), 'keywords': {'origin': player.hand, 'destination': player.base, 'cost_policy': ignore_energy}}) as f5:
        with phase('start'):
            if f5.new_template:
                born = p.instantiate(f5.template, f5.count, owner=f5.owner, controller=f5.controller, initial=f5.entry)
                f5.bind_newborn(born.value)
            p.zone_change(f5.objects, f5.origin, f5.chain_zone)
        with phase('enter_permanent'):
            p.zone_change(f5.objects, f5.chain_zone, f5.board, entry=f5.entry, entry_location=f5.entry_locations)
        with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
            p.zone_change(f5.objects, f5.chain_zone, f5.leave_destination)

    with action_frame('predict', {'positional': (player, 2), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:

        if f2.to_recycle:

                p.order_change(f2.to_recycle, f2.main_deck, position='bottom', order=f2.recycle_order)
        if f2.kept_on_top:
            p.order_change(f2.kept_on_top, f2.main_deck, position='top', order=f2.chosen_top_order)
    with action_frame('draw', {'positional': (player, 1), 'keywords': {}}) as f3:
        p.zone_change(f3.objects, f3.origin, f3.destination)
    with action_frame('change_xp', {'positional': (player, 1), 'keywords': {}}) as f4:
        p.xp_change(f4.player, f4.amount, operation=f4.operation)

source_program:
# 打出/变休眠触发
ops.play(recruit, p, origin=None, destination=p.base)
# 持续入口
ops.modify_might([me], n, duration=WHILE_SOURCE_PRESENT)
primitive_program:
with action_frame('play', {'positional': (recruit, player), 'keywords': {'origin': None, 'destination': player.base}}) as f1:
    with phase('start'):
        if f1.new_template:
            born = p.instantiate(f1.template, f1.count, owner=f1.owner, controller=f1.controller, initial=f1.entry)
            f1.bind_newborn(born.value)
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.chain_zone)
    with phase('enter_permanent'):
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.board, entry=f1.entry, entry_location=f1.entry_locations)
    with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
        p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.leave_destination)
with action_frame('modify_might', {'positional': ([me], n), 'keywords': {'duration': WHILE_SOURCE_PRESENT}}) as f2:
    p.might_contribute(f2.objects, 'ARITHMETIC', f2.snapshot_change, duration=f2.duration)

# 固有as_attach注册
ops.on_event(events, ability, duration=WHILE_SOURCE_PRESENT, timing="inline", link=link)
# 装配主动

if paid.value is not None:
    ops.attach(me, host)
# 内联执行体
r = ops.choose(p, originals, targeting=False, bind_at="resolution", link=link)
if r.value:
    ops.copy(host, r.value[0], duration=WHILE_ATTACHED)

if paid.value is not None:
    with action_frame('attach', {'positional': (me, host), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
        p.attachment_set(f1.gear, f1.host)
r = flow.Choose(player=player, kind='object', candidates=originals, minimum=1, maximum=1, stage='resolution', targeting=False, shortage='as_many_as_possible')
if r.value:

bindings: eligible:list[Card]=己废牌单位;dest:Location/Zone=合法目的地;ignore_energy:CostPolicy=仅忽略Energy保留Power及其他费用;permit:PlayPermission=本次打出触发允许所选单位从己废牌打出
primitive_program:
cards = flow.Choose(player=player, kind='object', candidates=eligible, minimum=0, maximum=1, stage='finalization', targeting=True, shortage='as_many_as_possible').value
if cards:
    with action_frame('play', {'positional': (cards[0], player), 'keywords': {'origin': player.trash, 'destination': dest, 'cost_policy': ignore_energy, 'permission': permit}}) as f1:
        with phase('start'):
            if f1.new_template:
                born = p.instantiate(f1.template, f1.count, owner=f1.owner, controller=f1.controller, initial=f1.entry)
                f1.bind_newborn(born.value)
            p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.origin, f1.chain_zone)
        with phase('enter_permanent'):
            p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.board, entry=f1.entry, entry_location=f1.entry_locations)
        with phase('spell_leave_chain'):
            p.zone_change(f1.objects, f1.chain_zone, f1.leave_destination)

top = ops.look(p, p.main_deck, 3).value
one = ops.choose(p, top, targeting=False, bind_at="resolution").value
ops.transfer(one, p.main_deck, p.hand)
ops.recycle([c for c in top if c not in one])
primitive_program:
with action_frame('look', {'positional': (player, player.main_deck, 3), 'keywords': {}}) as f1:
    p.information_access(f1.objects, [f1.player], mode='LOOK', duration=UNTIL_EFFECT_END)
top = f1.result.value
one = flow.Choose(player=player, kind='object', candidates=top, minimum=1, maximum=1, stage='resolution', targeting=False, shortage='as_many_as_possible').value
with action_frame('transfer', {'positional': (one, player.main_deck, player.hand), 'keywords': {}}) as f2:
    p.zone_change(f2.objects, f2.origin, f2.destination, position=f2.position, order=f2.order)
with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': ([c for c in top if c not in one],), 'keywords': {}}) as f3:
    with flow.Batch(policy=SIMULTANEOUS):
        for group in f3.recycle_groups:
            if group.same_zone:
                p.order_change(group.objects, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)
            else:
                p.zone_change(group.objects, group.origin, group.deck, position='bottom', order=group.order)

top = f1.result.value

one = flow.Choose(player=player, kind='object', candidates=units_or_gear, minimum=0, maximum=1, stage='resolution', targeting=False, shortage='as_many_as_possible').value
if one:

with action_frame('recycle', {'positional': ([c for c in top if c not in one],), 'keywords': {}}) as f4:
